nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Documentation for the @ecommerce-platform/contracts library, describing its gRPC service definitions and event schemas, project layout, code generation workflow, and usage examples for consuming services.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM package manifest for @ecommerce-platform/contracts declaring module entry points, conditional exports for source and proto files, and runtime dependencies such as protobuf and gRPC libraries.

nodes.name: project.json
nodes.summary: Nx project configuration for the contracts library defining build, test, lint, typecheck, and proto generation/check targets along with asset copying of .proto files.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project references configuration that aggregates the library and spec tsconfig files for composite builds and type checking.

nodes.name: tsconfig.lib.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the contracts library build, setting output directory, root directory, and excluding test files.

nodes.name: tsconfig.spec.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the contracts test suite, including Jest types and referencing the library tsconfig.
